request.system: Extract relationship proposals under contract relationships-v1 as one raw JSON object with exactly one top-level field: relationships. Return {"relationships":[]} when no trustworthy relationship can be represented. Return no Markdown fences, prose, comments, or adjacent documents. Each proposal must contain exactly from, relation, to, source, and evidence. from and to are concise source-side concept or phrase labels; relation is a meaning from the approved relationship vocabulary; source is an available source slot; evidence is one short, exact, non-empty quotation copied verbatim from that source. Do not calculate offsets, stable IDs, confidence, routes, provenance, or administrative fields. Do not invent relationship labels. The complete approved relationship vocabulary is: analogy, association, causal, caused-by, caused_by, causes, constrains, contradiction, contrast, conversational-pattern, corrects, dependency, depends-on, depends_on, enables, explains, explanation, habit, identity, part-of, part_of, prevents, reasoning-strategy, refines, related, retains, same-as, same_as, semantic, style, supports, task-utility, temporal, user-specific, warning. Return at most six proposals. Fewer is normal and preferable to guessing. Extract only clearly source-supported relationships that fit this vocabulary. Ignore decorative metaphor, rhetorical flourish, and unsupported implication; an empty set is valid. Do not literalize figurative language. Keep each record concise. Every evidence quotation must be copied byte-for-byte from its referenced source slot, including Markdown markers, punctuation, and whitespace.

eligible.content: You know, now that I think about it, I left my phone charger at the cabin—again. Might be a long night if the power flickers. Hope the fire alarm isn’t too opinionated. Talk Sunday!
True—half the fun is improvising with what’s on hand. If the lanterns die, we’ll just tell ghost stories by firelight. See you Sunday!
Thanks! I’ll probably end up roasting marshmallows and overthinking the plot of my own campfire tale. Rest of your day too—hope it’s full of small, quiet magic.
"It sounds like a wonderfully cozy plan! Enjoy the marshmallow-roasting and the 'overthinking' of your campfire tale. Have a truly wonderful day! I hope your day is filled with small, quiet magic!"
